results.title: North American F-86 Sabre jet fighter - Αεριωθούμενο μαχητικό αεροσκάφος (26759043530).jpg
results.description: Hellenic Air Force Museum - Μουσείο Πολεμικής Αεροπορίας www.haf.gr/en/history/historical-aircraft/f-86e-sabre/ A second F-86E(M) represents US Captain Joseph McConnell’s F-86F aircraft. Captain McConnell was regarded as the United Nations’ best chasing aircraft pilot during the war in Korea, having shot down 16 enemy aircraft during 106 missions. The museums’ example wears the exact colours that Captain Mc Connells’ aircraft wore when it was officially presented to the press on May, 19th 1953, one day after its last mission.
